en: Duran - From here on is western Cutis territory. The Imperial convoy should pass along the river to the west before long. Either way, we had better hurry.
Iyolin - Can we trust the report that the Scepter of Glory is among the convoy's cargo? Moving a treasure as important as the Scepter would be a great risk.
Duran - It seems the Imperial Chancellor, a man named Beradin, has need of the Scepter of Glory. He has been excavating ruins all over the land of late, and he appears to need the Scepter's power.

Duran - The Scepter of Glory is one of the Three Treasures of Pandragon, handed down since ancient times with the holy sword Stormbringer and the Crown of Supremacy. Stormbringer holds the sealed power of lightning and destroys every evil being. The Crown raises an invisible barrier that blunts all physical attacks and protects its wearer. The Scepter of Glory nullifies all magic. Beradin must mean to use it to break the guardian spells of the ancient ruins.

Iyolin - Whatever the reason, this is a chance we cannot let slip. The Three Treasures belong to the royal house of Pandragon. We cannot leave them to the likes of the Empire's Beradin. Whatever the danger, this mission must succeed.
Duran - One thing is certain: the Imperial troops will not be caught off guard. This convoy may even be a trap.
Locarno - Heh heh. If it's a trap, all the better. Let's teach them a lesson they won't forget.
Duran - Locarno! Prince Rashid has joined us on this mission. How can you talk so recklessly? If anything happened to the prince or the princess, it would be the end of Pandragon!
Iyolin - Enough, both of you. Even if it is a trap, we have no choice but to go ahead. Let's rest a while in the nearby village, then begin the operation.
